preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The length of the string S for each test case must be between 2 and 5000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in {'A', 'B'} for c in S)
preconditions.description: The string S must consist only of the characters 'A' and 'B'.

postconditions.description: The output must be either -1 or a valid subsequence that appears exactly twice in S.

postconditions.expression: any(stdout == T for T in subsequences if subsequences[T] == 2)
postconditions.description: If a valid subsequence is output, it must appear exactly twice in S.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not any(subsequences[T] == 2 for T in subsequences) else True
postconditions.description: If no subsequence appears exactly twice, the output must be -1.
